title: Thoughts and worries in early stages of motherhood 3
summary: The aim of the study is to investigate the extent to which stress factors, such as anxiety and depression, are related to potential protective factors, such as resilience, in pregnant women. For this purpose, pregnant women in their third trimester are surveyed using paper questionnaire.

interventions.name: Pregnant women in the third trimester take part in a baseline assessment using validated questionnaires. The following constructs are assessed: fear of childbirth, depression, general anxiety and perceived stress, general as well as pregnancy-related adverse experiences, self-efficacy, social suppor

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Pregnant women in the third trimester
• Sufficient German language skills to participate in the questionnaire survey
• Written informed consent to participate in the study
Exclusion criteria:
•Severe maternal comorbidities (according to the investigator’s assessment)
•Known severe fetal or neonatal conditions that would require transfer of the newborn to the neonatal unit
•Severe psychological disorders in the woman
•Lack of cognitive, physical, or language abilities of the woman to participate in the questionnaire survey
